t: Contract Manufacturing of Finished Products - CTA Manufacturing
s: By manufacturing a pre-serie, we get to show a concrete output to our Clients, all the while finetuning the manufcaturing procedures used for the specific product. The pre-serie phase is the step when the motor warms up, seat belts get fastened and the adventure begins. By delegating to CTA the procurement of materials involved in the manufacturing processes, it is possible to further optimize the management of the finished product and to release the Customer from all the operative activites linked to the supply of raw materials and components.
